name: skills.sh
license: index of community skills; per-skill licenses vary
description: The open agent-skills ecosystem: leaderboard, topics, official packs, audits, and install commands.
why: The fastest way to discover a skill before vendoring it. Always check the source repository license.

name: vercel-labs/skills
description: The find-skills skill and the Skills CLI source.
why: Teaches an agent how to search and install from the ecosystem instead of guessing.

name: Anthropic Skills
description: Anthropic's official skill collection: frontend design, skill creator, MCP builder, webapp testing, canvas, documents, and more.
why: High-quality reference implementations for skill structure and agent workflows.

name: Superpowers
description: A large skill system for planning, debugging, TDD, code review, parallel agents, and verification.
why: One of the strongest open collections for disciplined engineering workflows.

name: Matt Pocock skills
description: Engineering and productivity skills including grilling, domain modeling, codebase design, triage, and spec writing.
why: Excellent TypeScript and product-engineering judgement encoded as skills.

name: Addy Osmani Agent Skills
description: Broad engineering skill set covering planning, specs, code quality, debugging, performance, security, and shipping.
why: A well-organized, practical set that maps cleanly onto real delivery work.

name: system_prompts_leaks
description: Archive of public system prompts and agent skills from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, and others, updated frequently.
why: Useful for studying how production agents structure instructions. This repository vendors a curated developer-relevant subset only.

name: Agent-Reach
description: One CLI for reading and searching Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu without API fees.
why: Gives agents eyes on social and video platforms through a single interface.

name: ego lite
description: A Chromium browser designed for humans and agents, with a dedicated ego-browser skill.
why: Lets an agent use the user's logged-in browser context instead of a blank automation profile.

name: Vercel Agent Browser
description: Browser automation CLI built for AI agents, with snapshots and ref-based interaction.
why: A practical alternative when ego lite is not available.

name: Playwright MCP
description: Playwright's accessibility-tree browser automation exposed as an MCP server.
why: Deterministic browser actions and verification for agents that support MCP.

name: Chrome DevTools MCP
description: Chrome DevTools exposed to agents for performance traces, console, network, and DOM inspection.
why: Closes the loop between 'it renders' and 'it is fast and correct'.

name: Browser Use
description: Python library that lets agents control a browser through natural-language actions.
why: A mature option for scripted browser agents outside a single IDE.

name: Firecrawl
description: Turn websites into LLM-ready markdown or structured data.
why: Reliable extraction for docs, research, and lead enrichment.

name: Crawl4AI
description: Open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper.
why: A self-hosted alternative when you do not want a hosted scraping service.

name: Context7
description: Up-to-date library documentation exposed to agents through MCP.
why: Reduces hallucinated APIs by giving the agent current docs.

name: Repomix
description: Packs a repository into a single AI-friendly file with structure and token counts.
why: Useful for whole-repo analysis when an agent cannot browse the filesystem.

name: Serena
description: Semantic code retrieval and editing tools exposed through MCP.
why: Gives agents symbol-level navigation instead of grep-only editing.

name: Antigravity Boost (/boost)
license: Google documentation; no portable skill license established
description: Built-in Antigravity command for difficult engineering tasks, with specialized subagents, improvement rounds, and independent verification.
why: Documents the exact /boost feature requested here. This is a host capability; no portable SKILL.md is being invented or substituted.
verification: Official product documentation checked; linked rather than copied.

name: Antigravity Custom Subagents
description: Official guide to background subagents and the Boost, Swarm, and Teamwork orchestrators.
why: Explains host configuration and orchestration choices without presenting built-in capabilities as portable skills.
verification: Official product documentation checked; linked rather than copied.
